sinks.rationale: ejs.render(template, data) evaluates <% %> blocks in the template string as JavaScript; an attacker-chosen template is server-side code execution.
ejs.compile(template) compiles the template string into a function whose invocation runs its <% %> blocks.
pug.render(source, options) evaluates JavaScript expressions and unbuffered code in the source string; attacker templates execute.
pug.compile(source) compiles the source string; rendering the compiled template runs its embedded JavaScript.
Handlebars.compile(input) compiles the template string; attacker templates reach helpers/partials and known prototype-chain escape gadgets.
mustache.render(template, view) is logic-less, so the injection yields data exfiltration from the view rather than code execution — still an attacker-controlled template.
nunjucks.renderString(str, context) renders the string as a template with expression evaluation; classic SSTI-to-RCE surface.
_.template(string) compiles interpolate/evaluate delimiters into a Function body; an attacker template is direct code execution.
